secrets.name: DATABASE_URL
secrets.description: Neon Postgres connection string for the API (apps/api). Optional: the API falls back to in-memory storage when unset. Set to enable persistent license/wallet data.

secrets.name: REFERRAL_SIGNING_SECRET
secrets.description: Secret used to sign/verify affiliate referral tokens in the API. Optional at boot; referral endpoints log a warning and return unsigned tokens when unset.

secrets.name: RESEND_API_KEY
secrets.description: Resend API key for transactional email (license delivery, support tickets) in the API. Optional; email sending is skipped when unset.

secrets.name: COINGECKO_API_KEY
secrets.description: CoinGecko Demo API key for crypto price/search endpoints. Optional; public rate-limited endpoints are used when unset.

secrets.name: NOWPAYMENTS_API_KEY
secrets.description: NOWPayments API key for crypto checkout. Optional; crypto checkout is unavailable when unset.

secrets.name: NOWPAYMENTS_IPN_SECRET
secrets.description: NOWPayments IPN webhook secret for verifying payment notifications. Optional.

secrets.name: SELLAUTH_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: SellAuth webhook secret for the Dynamic Delivery callback that returns generated license keys. Optional; webhook signature verification is skipped when unset.
